title: 第 5 章 天道姻缘，同生共死
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你身为我的未婚夫，我帮你们问天宗发现魔族你不谢谢我就算了，你还拿剑指着我，你还污蔑我跟那个魔族有关系。”

“我要是跟那个魔族有关系，我举报他做什么？”

“你这么对我，不就是不满意你跟我的天道姻缘吗，那我们退婚就行了。”

“从此你过你的奈何桥，我走我的阳关道，你们问天宗我不再踏入半步，呜呜呜呜。”

“小师叔，这是小师婶啊？”问天宗弟子都懵了。

特别是听昭杺柠一番哭诉。

再结合钟离珟刚刚确实拔剑对着昭杺柠，这让问天宗弟子看钟离珟的目光都变了。

毕竟天道姻缘线的双方，只要有个星级修炼天赋，都能看见自己的姻缘对象是谁，也能看见双方手腕那根红线。

而钟离珟，8星修为，不可能看不见自己跟昭杺柠之间的天道姻缘线。

所以，钟离珟是明知道昭杺柠是他的未婚妻，还拔剑威胁？

意识到这一点以后，这让问天宗众弟子看向钟离珟的目光都变了。

想不到，钟离珟居然是这样的小师叔……

呸！不要脸！

钟离珟盯着抽了他一巴掌，反而还在那哭唧唧的昭杺柠，啧声一笑。

从刚刚昭杺柠在广场出现，他远远跟昭杺柠对视的第一眼，钟离珟就知道这女人不是善茬。

回想昭杺柠当时还主动对自己甜甜一笑，钟离珟更是笃定自己看人的眼光不会错。

昭杺柠，确实不是个善茬。

心中如此想，钟离珟却是长腿一迈，又往昭杺柠靠近一步。

“呜呜呜……”昭杺柠抬手擦着眼角泪水。

注意到钟离珟的靠近，她哭泣抖着肩膀正要后退，却见钟离珟站立在她面前，抱拳对她一拜。

再次出声，是钟离珟满含歉意开口：“刚刚是钟离误会了，还望未婚妻勿怪。”

“谈不上什么怪不怪的。”钟离珟主动道歉，想着这里是钟离珟的地盘，昭杺柠也见好就收。

昭杺柠擦掉泪水，笑着看向众人还故作大度装了一把：“毕竟我们身为人类，共同的敌人应该是魔族。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"As my fiancé, I helped you Wentian Sect discover the demon clan and forget it if you don't thank me. You pointed a sword at me and slandered me for having something to do with that demon clan."

"If I have anything to do with that demon, why should I report him?"

"Aren't you just dissatisfied with your heavenly marriage to me when you treat me like this? Then we can just break off the engagement."

"From now on, you cross your Naihe Bridge and I take my Yangguan Road. I will never take another step forward in your Wentian Sect, woo woo woo."

"Uncle Junior, is this Junior Auntie?" The Wentian Sect disciples were all confused.

Especially after hearing Zhao Hao Ning cry.

Combined with the fact that Zhong Lizui had just drawn his sword and pointed it at Zhao Hao Ning, this made the Wentian Sect disciples look at Zhong Lizui differently.

After all, both parties on the marriage line of heaven, as long as they have a star-level cultivation talent, can see who their marriage partner is, and they can also see the red line on both parties' wrists.

As for Zhongli Sui, with an 8-star cultivation level, it was impossible for him to not see the heavenly marriage line between himself and Zhao Hao Ning.

So, did Zhong Lizui know clearly that Zhao Hao Ning was his fiancée, and yet he drew his sword and threatened her?

After realizing this, the eyes of the disciples of Wentian Sect changed when they looked at Zhong Lizui.

Unexpectedly, Zhong Lizui would be such a junior uncle...

Bah!shameless!

Zhong Lizui stared at Zhao Haining, who was still crying after she slapped him, and then smiled.

From the moment Zhao Hao Ning appeared in the square and the first time he looked at Zhao Hao Ning from a distance, Zhong Lizui knew that this woman was not a good person.

Recalling that Zhao Haining took the initiative to smile sweetly at him, Zhongli Sui was even more certain that his vision of people was not wrong.

Zhao Huning is indeed not a good person.

With this thought in his mind, Zhongli Sui took a long step forward and took another step closer to Zhao Hao Ning.

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" Zhao Hao Ning raised her hand to wipe the tears from the corners of her eyes.

Noticing Zhong Lizui's approach, she cried and shook her shoulders and was about to back away, when she saw Zhong Lizui standing in front of her, clasping his fists and bowing to her.

It was Zhongli who spoke again, apologetically: "Zhongli just misunderstood, I hope my fiancée won't blame me."

"It's hard to say whether it's weird or not." Zhongli Sui took the initiative to apologize, thinking that this was Zhongli Sui's territory, and Zhao Hao Ning would also accept it.

Zhao Hao Ning wiped away her tears, looked at everyone with a smile, and pretended to be generous: "After all, as human beings, our common enemy should be the demons."
